history.action: route plan -> implement -> review -> qa (model, confidence 90)

acceptance.check: Dashboard ideal state lists Meta campaigns, ad sets, ads and insights tables from the fake provider, each with a row count and rows sorted deterministically by id
acceptance.how_to_verify: Boot with seed data, open /, confirm four tables with counts and id-sorted rows

acceptance.check: Adapter contract suite runs the identical read sequence (campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights) against the fake provider and the credential-gated live path with zero business-logic changes between runs
acceptance.how_to_verify: CI runs test/integrations/meta_ads.test.js contract cases against both providers

acceptance.check: With the fake provider set to quota-exhausted or permission-revoked, the dashboard error panel names the failing check (provider-sync/quota or provider-sync/permission), shows the last-good sync timestamp, offers Retry, and keeps the prior campaign rows visible
acceptance.how_to_verify: Open /?meta_error=quota and /?meta_error=revoked, confirm named error, timestamp, retry button and preserved rows

acceptance.check: The pinned Graph API version is defined in exactly one exported constant and the fake provider implements every method of the typed read interface
acceptance.how_to_verify: CI runs the version-pin and full-interface cases in test/integrations/meta_ads.test.js

acceptance.check: A versioned Meta read adapter behind a typed interface ships campaigns, ad sets, ads and insights reads first with a fake provider for tests and simulation
acceptance.how_to_verify: CI runs the adapter contract suite; dashboard renders its data in a browser

alternatives_considered.approach: Expose GET /v1/meta/* HTTP endpoints for the reads
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The dashboard is server-rendered and can call the in-process adapter directly; new HTTP surface adds versioning and error-envelope work with no operator value in a read-first slice, and the issue names the contract as the JS interface behind src/integrations/meta_ads

alternatives_considered.approach: Persist synced Meta rows into SQLite derived_metrics
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Meta reads are raw source payloads owned by the provider, not derived metrics; persisting them now would mix raw and derived storage and break the TR-20 separation the foundation slice just established

validated_work_order.approach: Add a versioned Meta adapter behind a typed read interface in src/integrations/meta_ads with the Graph version pinned in exactly one exported constant: index.js holds the contract (version constant, typed shapes, error envelope, deterministic sort, credential gating), fake.js implements the full interface with deterministic fixture data plus quota/revoked failure injection, and live.js implements the same interface over fetch with the pinned version in every URL and is only constructible when META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN is present (otherwise it returns META_NOT_CONFIGURED and never logs secrets). Extend the dashboard in src/web/pages.js with campaign regions (campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights tables with row counts and id sort) covering ideal, empty (existing no-connected-account checklist), loading (skeletons), partial (stale banner) and error (named failing check plus last-good timestamp plus Retry, prior rows preserved via a last-good cache) states. Cover with an adapter contract suite run identically against fake and live plus dashboard region tests. Owner decision from plan/brief.md is followed: Meta end to end first; spec section 37 (Google-first wedge) is stale and overridden by that decision.
assumptions: Graph API pinned version v24.0 is current enough; currency is not asserted, only single-definition pinning
No Meta app credentials exist in CI or QA, so the live path is only ever exercised as credential-gated refusal
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Adapter pattern, dashboard states, and test layout all already exist in the repo (fake-provider convention, five-state pages, node:test mirroring src/); the only new surface is the Meta read interface, which is read-only and credential-gated, so blast radius is small.

files.change: Export GRAPH_API_VERSION single constant, typed read interface (listCampaigns, listAdSets, listAds, getInsights), typed error envelope {code,message,details,retryable} with codes META_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, META_PERMISSION_REVOKED, META_NOT_CONFIGURED, META_NETWORK, credential-gating helper, and deterministic by-id sort helper

FakeMetaAdsProvider implementing the full typed interface with deterministic fixture data (3 campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights with integer spend_micros), id-sorted output, and injectable failure modes ok|quota|revoked for tests and simulation

LiveMetaAdsProvider implementing the same interface over global fetch with the pinned version interpolated into every request URL, env-credential gating (META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN), 429/403 mapped to typed quota/permission errors, boundary validation of provider JSON (parse, never cast), secrets never logged

Dashboard gains Meta campaign regions: campaigns, ad sets, ads and insights tables each with row counts and deterministic id sort; ideal shows live fake data with last-good sync timestamp, empty keeps the existing connect-Meta checklist, loading shows skeleton KPI/campaign cards without layout shift, partial shows stale-provider banner with age, error names the failing check (provider-sync/quota or provider-sync/permission), shows last-good timestamp, offers Retry button (focus moves to it), and preserves prior rows from the last-good cache; tables expose headers and row counts, single column under 900px

out_of_scope: IAC-none deferred: all four IACs are covered in this slice
Meta writes, drafts and budgets (later slice of the same adapter)
Policy kernel and executor (separate safety ticket)
Google Ads integration (later epic reusing this slice, per owner decision in plan/brief.md)
qa_script: npm run sdlc:serve, open http://localhost:3000/ and confirm campaign, ad-set, ad and insights tables with row counts and id-sorted rows plus a last-good sync timestamp
Open /?state=empty (connect-Meta checklist), /?state=loading (skeletons), /?state=partial (stale banner), /?state=error (retry panel naming what failed and what is still true)
Open /?meta_error=quota and /?meta_error=revoked and confirm the named check, last-good timestamp, Retry button, and preserved prior rows
npm run sdlc:verify for the adapter contract and dashboard region suites
risks: Live provider targets graph.facebook.com, which is not in env.api_allowlist; it is credential-gated and never called without owner-supplied META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN, so QA stays local-only, but a person must allowlist the host before any live-read ticket
Dashboard error copy names graph.facebook.com in text only (no request is sent); no data leaves the runner

cases: contract reads run identically against fake and live providers: campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights shapes, row counts and deterministic id sort with zero business-logic changes
quota exhaustion and revoked permission surface as named typed errors with retryable flags on both providers
live provider without META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN returns META_NOT_CONFIGURED and never touches the network
GRAPH_API_VERSION is defined in exactly one constant and every live request URL contains it
fake provider implements every method of the typed read interface
dashboard ideal renders the four Meta tables with row counts and id-sorted rows from the fake provider
dashboard error with meta_error=quota/revoked names the failing check, shows last-good timestamp, offers Retry, and preserves prior rows
dashboard loading/partial/error preview shells keep skeletons, stale banner and retry without touching storage

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #18 is the first Meta Ads slice of epic #14: a read-only Meta adapter (campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights) behind src/integrations/meta_ads with a fake provider for tests/simulation and a credential-gated live path, plus dashboard campaign regions with ideal/empty/loading/error states. Binding owner decision (plan/brief.md): Meta end to end first, Google Ads later, which overrides the Google-first argument in spec section 37. Depends on #16 (done): boot, SQLite repositories, five-state pages, and sdlc verbs all exist to build on.
